description: WCAG 2.2 contrast check with the minimal OKLCH lightness fix and colour-blind pair check — Checks up to 50 foreground/background hex pairs against a WCAG 2.2 contrast threshold (4.5 AA text, 3 large text and UI, 7 AAA, or your own) on the unrounded ratio, so 4.499 fails and exactly 4.5 passes, and for a failing pair returns the closest colour by OKLCH lightness (chroma and hue held, gamut-clipped, 8-bit) that meets it. Optionally simulates protanomaly, deuteranomaly and tritanomaly (Mac

cvdMinDeltaE.description: Smallest OKLab distance counted as distinguishable (default 0.05, a heuristic, not a standard).

cvdSeverity.description: Enables the colour-vision-deficiency check at this severity, 0 to 1 (1.0 is dichromacy); between the published 0.1 steps the matrices are interpolated.

fixTarget.description: Which colour to move for a failing pair (default foreground); none skips the fix.

level.description: aa-normal 4.5 (default), aa-large 3, aaa-normal 7, aaa-large 4.5, non-text 3 (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3, 1.4.6, 1.4.11).

claimedRatio.description: A ratio the caller asserts; compared to the unrounded ratio with a 0.01 tolerance.

foreground.description: #rgb or #rrggbb (strict hex; no names, no alpha).

threshold.description: Overrides level: the minimum contrast ratio.

name: contrast-fix
